summary: The look patch does what it claims for the yellow findings. On a clean copy, 26 affected modules (564 tests per look) pass in both looks. The new tests catch real faults: putting back the PDF fill, the old writing-line light or the old Field light each makes a new test fail. The builder's numbers reproduce exactly (warm light counts, colour-vision table of 25 and 11 pairs, Graphite frame counts). Graphite is unchanged by construction except the reworded Log note. Two things must be fixed before merge. (1) The key sweep is incomplete. KEYS cannot see a key in brackets, so the Finder's Preview tip '(Space)', which the walk itself reads on Today, still passes. About a dozen other shown strings still name a key (Reading preferences, the Manual's count line, a Field status line and close tip, the clip menu, status messages, the empty workspace). (2) The tools/check_head_ui.py hunk conflicts with the checks item, which deletes that file. The edited line is unreachable anyway, so drop the hunk. Should-fix items: the desk-light test's limit was loosened (0.305 to 0.4 in luminance) without saying so; KEYS false positives; one tip uses 'line' for a menu row; GETTING_STARTED's 'Apps at the upper right' does not fit Kasandra's logo button; visible Kasandra changes to judge by eye (stepped line light; rings under overlapping sheets; the Return thread's writing box now blue); gaps in the colour-vision table; a fragile loop in named_in. Not done: frames were not retaken (the builder's were recounted); check_head_ui was run but fails before the changed line on any current tree; nothing ran on the owner's ThinkPad.
